item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Pulse 0.16.5
item.description:
Mac Menu Bar Stock Quote Software

Pulse is a stock and market ticker tool that runs in the macOS menu bar, allowing users to quickly view the prices of their watchlist stocks without switching app windows, and to open their watchlist, position P&L, and price alerts with a single click. The software covers the U.S., Hong Kong, China A-shares, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and European markets, and also supports cryptocurrencies, precious metals, indices, ETFs, and Polymarket prediction markets. The source of market data and the refresh rate vary by market and are indicated as real-time or delayed. Pulse offers multiple customizable watchlists, candlestick and volume charts, pre-market and after-hours quotes, as well as daily and position P&L summarized by market, making it easy for users to understand the impact of different markets and individual stocks on their portfolio. Users can set alerts for prices or predicted probabilities, and can also display market quotes at the top of the menu bar. The number of positions held, costs, and transaction records are stored locally. The prediction market function is used to view probabilities and record contract positions. It does not support placing trades. The software can also connect to AI tools such as Claude, Codex, and Cursor via MCP, which runs only on the local machine, to manage underlying assets, groups, and transaction records in natural language;

item.title: Slidepad 2.0.3
item.description:
Mac Web Page Quick Access Tool

Slidepad is a slide-in browser for macOS 15 and later that brings web tools to the edge of your desktop when you need them and automatically retracts them when you don't, reducing the disruption of extra windows to your workflow. Users can move the pointer to a designated edge or corner of the screen to bring up the browser, and it will retract when the pointer is moved away, without the need to rearrange other windows. The software supports the creation of separate browsing profiles for personal, work, and client use, making it easy to switch between different browsing scenarios. It also allows the use of installed Safari web extensions, such as ad blockers and password managers, in each browsing panel. Through iCloud, panels, configurations, bookmarks, and preferences can be synced across multiple Macs, while login information and browsing data remain on their respective devices. Slidepad also offers an MCP Server that can connect to compatible tools such as Codex, Claude, and Cursor, enabling them to work with the web pages that are currently visible and accessible to the user. It is ideal for Mac users who need to frequently view web pages, messages, and online tools while keeping their desktops tidy. A 30-day trial is available.

item.title: Pake 1.11.0
item.description:
macOS Tool for Converting Any Website Page to an App

Pake is a tool that packages any web page or online service into a standalone desktop application, compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux. In the desktop version, users can select from a curated list of websites or paste a URL to create an application through a graphical interface. They can also customize the application's icon, window, title bar, and background behavior. The desktop version does not require the installation of development environments such as Node.js or Rust. Users who are familiar with the terminal can also use the free, open-source CLI to generate multi-platform installation packages with a single command and can build or customize projects online with GitHub Actions. Pake uses the computer's existing system browser components to display web pages, so there is no need to bundle a full browser with the application. As a result, the installation package is usually less than 10 MB. The application can have its own icon and window, and it can also be pinned to the Dock or the system's list of applications. The desktop version supports macOS Apple silicon and Intel devices, as well as Windows and Linux. The created applications do not rely on Pake or licenses and can be used independently. Configurations can also be exported and recreated on other computers.

item.title: DepthField Photo 1.2.1
item.description:
macOS AI-powered photo editing

DepthField Photo is a professional photo editing software for macOS that combines traditional tools such as layers, masks, color and print controls with AI-powered selections, generative edits, and scene depth editing. It can retouch portraits, adjust expressions and eye gaze, remove objects and their shadows and reflections, replace backgrounds and weather conditions, extend image edges, reconstruct scenes, or modify selected content based on text descriptions. The software can recognize depth information in photos for post-shooting refocusing, adding bokeh, lighting, fog effects, and tilt-shift effects, and supports controlling painting and compositing based on real depth of field. Features such as automatic light and color correction, perspective correction, noise reduction, blur correction, restoration of old photos, and enlargement cover common editing needs. The editor offers non-destructive real-time filters, up to 1,000 undo steps, 16-bit color, CMYK soft-proofing, support for formats like PSD, and brush import compatibility with Photoshop and Krita. Most tools run natively on Mac, support Apple Silicon and Core ML, and can also connect to multiple image generation models.

item.title: PocketWebTools 1.1.1
item.description:
Read Aloud Selected Text on Mac

PocketWebTools for Mac is a suite of native AI and utility tools for Apple Silicon Macs, bringing together cross-app text processing, audio and video editing, image enhancement, and document recognition in a single window. Users can hold down a shortcut key to dictate content into any text box, have selected text read aloud, or directly rewrite emails, notes, and other text in place. The software offers local model chat, multilingual speech transcription, system audio capture, speaker labeling for up to four speakers, speech synthesis, and voice cloning. It can also edit long videos into short clips with subtitles, completing video editing by modifying the transcribed text. The image tool supports full-resolution image cutout, background removal, batch photo enlargement, and HEIC and RAW format processing. The Document Tool can extract text from PDFs and scanned documents in bulk, preserve tables and formulas, and generate Markdown or searchable PDFs. Built-in everyday tools such as word count, format conversion, JSON formatting, and password generation. Models are downloaded on demand, and the appropriate setting is recommended based on memory capacity. Once the download is complete, core processing can run offline, and chat, audio recordings, photos, and document content remain on the local device.

item.title: Nacre Voice 1.0.50
item.description:
Multilingual Translation Software for Mac

Nacre Voice is a speech-to-text and text-processing tool for macOS that allows you to dictate directly into your current applications, such as email, chat apps, documents, and browsers. Press the shortcut key to start speaking, and press it again to paste the edited text at the cursor position. The software will remove filler words, repetitions, and mid-sentence corrections, automatically add punctuation, and adjust the tone based on the application in use. After selecting the text, you can also proofread, rewrite, translate, or read it aloud using quick actions. The software also offers features such as real-time call captions, meeting recordings and summaries, a personal dictionary, voice phrases, and a history log. Dictation, proofreading, and translation are supported in English, French, Spanish, German, and Italian, with the translation feature covering even more languages. The free version offers a weekly dictation limit of 1,000 words, with access to features such as proofreading and translation. The Pro version removes the dictation limit. History, meeting content, dictionaries, and settings are stored locally on the Mac. The app supports both Apple silicon and Intel-based Macs, and requires macOS 14 or later.

item.title: Oink 0.3.7
item.description:
Cross-device keyboard and mouse sharing

Oink is a peer-to-peer collaboration and software KVM tool for macOS and Windows computers that enables multiple devices to work together as a single system. Once installed, users can control other nearby computers using the keyboard, mouse, or trackpad on any device, without the need to designate a fixed master device. Cross-screen operations remain natural and smooth, and trackpad gestures are supported. Oink can automatically synchronize clipboards between devices and also allows direct dragging and dropping of text, images, and files, making it easy to transfer content between different computers or to drag files into applications. It can also route audio from multiple devices to the speakers or headphones connected to one of the computers, making audio output more flexible. The software automatically detects devices on the local area network, uses a peer-to-peer network architecture, and encrypts all network transmissions by default. Oink was developed from scratch, using its own communication protocol, and is not compatible with other software KVMs. The Mac version supports Apple chips and Intel processors and requires macOS 14.2 or later. The Windows version supports specified versions of Windows 10 and Windows 11.

item.title: Folia 0.8.2
item.description:
Immersive Lyrics Music Player for Mac

Folia is a cross-platform music player centered around immersive full-screen lyric playback. It offers a macOS desktop version that integrates local music libraries, Navidrome, and multi-platform online music into a single playback environment. The software supports NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou Music, and QQ Music. The desktop version can also access Polka Music, YouTube Music, Spotify, and Soda Music. After searching for a song, artist, or album, you can play it and load the cover art and lyrics. It features a variety of lyric animations with different typographic styles. The visual parameters can be adjusted, and the animations automatically adapt to the window size, providing a viewing experience similar to that of a lyric music video. AI theme generation can combine the mood of the song and the content of the lyrics to generate backgrounds and visual parameters. After importing local music, only the index is saved locally, and the audio content is not uploaded. It supports reading metadata, album covers, and various lyrics files, and automatically matches online lyrics. If there is an error in the matching, it can be corrected manually. The desktop version also features the Folium mod system, which can extend lyric animations, backgrounds, playback page layers, and audio sources;

item.title: Thor 1.5.18
item.description:
App Quick Launcher

Thor Launcher is an excellent Mac custom shortcut key launcher that helps you set shortcut keys for applications, allowing you to quickly open or switch applications using shortcut keys. When you are running many applications at the same time, Thor is more efficient than repeatedly pressing the Command – Tab keys, as it gets the job done in one step. Thor is a Mac productivity app that allows you to set keyboard shortcuts for specific apps, enabling you to quickly open and switch between apps using those shortcuts. Open-source app, Respect!

item.title: ShichiZip 0.4.0
item.description:
Mac Compressed File Manager

ShichiZip is a 7-Zip-based compressed file management tool natively rebuilt for macOS. It offers an experience on Mac that is similar to 7-Zip File Manager, making it suitable for users who need to manage multiple compressed file formats, quickly extract files, and view archive contents. The software supports all formats supported by the upstream 7-Zip and can centrally handle daily compression and decompression tasks. One-click smart extraction automatically selects the appropriate destination and removes duplicate top-level folders, reducing directory nesting after extraction and the need for manual organization. With Quick Look, users can preview compressed archives in Finder and also preview files within the archive without extracting them, making it easy to confirm the contents before deciding on further actions. In line with macOS usage habits, the software offers a resource branch removal feature and integrates with Finder as much as possible.

item.title: Vorssaint 3.4.5
item.description:
Menu Bar All-in-One Toolbox

Vorssaint is a privacy-focused application that integrates multiple commonly used macOS tools into the menu bar. With just a click on an icon, users can access features such as per-app volume control, system monitoring, window switching and layout, clipboard history, file staging, app uninstallation, link cleanup, and keeping the system awake. It emphasizes out-of-the-box usability, requiring no additional audio drivers or complex configuration. All core functions run natively and are progressively enabled with optional permissions. The software also provides detailed tools for network traffic, temperature, battery status, power consumption, wake-on-lid-close, scroll direction, and cleaning mode, and allows modules to be enabled or hidden as needed. The interface can switch between a simple list and a grouped view. It supports switching between multiple languages, catering to the usage habits of different regions. At the same time, it maintains a design without accounts, cloud storage, or continuous tracking, ensuring that every feature in the menu bar is as lightweight and unobtrusive as possible. Vorssaint consolidates a comprehensive set of commonly used macOS tools into a single menu bar entry, focusing on volume, windows, system status, clipboard, file management, sleep control, and cleanup and maintenance. All modules can be enabled or hidden as needed, making it ideal for Mac users who want to centralize the management of frequently performed tasks.

item.title: MacPacker 1.3.1
item.description:
QuickLook Browse and Extract Tool for macOS Compressed Packages

MacPacker is a native macOS archive management tool developed as open-source software and serves as an alternative to 7-Zip on Mac. It supports reading and extracting over 40 archive, disk image, and compression formats, including ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, DMG, ISO, and various compound archives. Users can view the contents of compressed archives just like browsing folders, without needing to fully extract them first. They can also access nested archives, view files through the system's built-in previewer, and drag and drop the files they need to the desired location, avoiding the need to extract an entire large archive for just a small amount of content. The software supports directly modifying and re-saving ZIP archives, and can also open password-protected and encrypted archives. With Quick Look and Finder extensions, users can preview archived content by pressing the spacebar or extract it to the current location and a specified folder via the right-click menu. The interface offers breadcrumb navigation, sortable lists, and keyboard shortcuts similar to Finder, and identifies file formats based on their characteristics rather than just their extensions.

item.title: WailBrew 0.15.1
item.description:
Homebrew Graphical Interface Management Tool

WailBrew is a sleek and minimalist Homebrew package management graphical user interface (GUI) designed for macOS, making the use of command-line tools intuitive and modern. Users can easily install, update, and uninstall software packages with just a few simple clicks, without having to memorize complex commands or deal with terminal syntax. Built on the solid foundation of Homebrew, WailBrew offers a secure operation process and comprehensive error handling to ensure smooth package management. It supports real-time filtering and detailed information searches, helping users manage thousands of formulas and cask applications. WailBrew is not only suitable for ordinary users who prefer graphical interfaces, but also provides developers with a way to install via the Homebrew command line, demonstrating its practicality and flexibility. WailBrew makes Homebrew's powerful features even easier to use through a beautiful interface. WailBrew is a minimalist and visually appealing graphical user interface (GUI) for Homebrew package management. It offers macOS users an intuitive and modern operating experience, making the powerful capabilities of command-line tools easily accessible.

item.title: MiaoYan 4.12.0
item.description:
macOS Native Markdown Editor

MiaoYan is a lightweight Markdown laptop app designed to help users easily write beautiful sentences. It features purely local use for security while supporting features such as syntax highlighting, dark mode, and automatic document layout. Users can enjoy a minimalistic three-column design that includes folders, file lists, and an editor for a great visual experience. MiaoYan uses Swift5 for native development, outperforms traditional web applications, and provides a number of shortcuts to improve editing efficiency. Other features include document export, internal jumps, graph bed support, and support for LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, and Markmap brainstorming, making it a versatile writing tool.

item.title: WallpaperMachine 1.16.0
item.description:
Native Dynamic Wallpaper Tool for macOS

WallpaperMachine is a native live wallpaper app for Macs with Apple silicon. It can run Wallpaper Engine's scene wallpapers, video wallpapers, and web wallpapers on macOS 15 Sequoia and later versions. The app features built-in browsing and downloading from the Steam Workshop, allowing you to browse a vast amount of content without logging in. To download, you need a Steam account with Wallpaper Engine. For scene wallpapers, you also need to purchase the shared resources separately during installation. The interface is divided into three tabs: Discover, Installed, and Settings. After selecting a wallpaper, press Play to apply it to the desktop. Each monitor can have its wallpaper set independently or mirrored from another monitor, and zoom, frame rate, and volume can be configured separately. After enabling audio response, wallpapers designed for sound will move in sync with the content currently playing on the Mac. Media integration allows wallpapers with music displays to show the song that is currently playing. When running on battery power, you can choose to keep running, reduce the load according to the custom rendering scale and frame rate, or pause directly. Videos and scene wallpapers can also be used experimentally for lock screen animations.

item.title: OhMyShot 0.5.0
item.description:
Open-source screenshot and screen recording tool for Mac

OhMyShot is a native, open-source screen capture tool for Macs with Apple silicon, compatible with macOS 26 and later versions. It resides in the menu bar, does not poll when idle, and does not maintain a screen capture session. Screen capture supports cross-screen selection, windows, full screen, timed, and scrolling long screenshots. The screen can be frozen during selection, making it easy to capture content that appears briefly. After taking a screenshot, you can copy, save, drag out, or paste it onto the screen from the quick access card. You can also add arrows, numbers, and highlights, or blur and pixelate sensitive information. The built-in on-device text recognition feature can copy and translate text in images in situ, and can also search the history based on the content of screenshots. Optional model packages can further process Chinese, formulas, tables, and charts. Screen recordings can be exported as MP4 or GIF files, with support for system audio, microphone, and camera. After recording, they can be edited in Studio and enhanced with automatic zooming that follows the cursor. The software also offers pinned overlays, screen color picking, an edge-snapping pixel ruler, as well as shortcuts and Raycast integration. OhMyShot brings together screenshots, screen recordings, annotations, and on-device text recognition in the macOS menu bar.

item.title: TabFlick 0.28.0
item.description:
Mac Browser Tab Switcher

TabFlick is a browser tab switching and unified search tool for macOS that works with browser extensions through native apps to provide a recent Arc-like switching experience for Chrome, Edge, Brave, and other Chromium browsers. Hold down Control and tap Tab to browse the tabs, release the button to confirm the switch, make the round trip between the two commonly used pages more stable, and do not mistakenly mark the passing tag as used. The software supports page thumbnails, landscape bars, and grid layouts, and preserves a separate order of use by window. The search panel can centrally find open and recently closed tags, bookmarks, history, favorite folders, and installed apps. It supports full Chinese spelling and phonetic initial matching, single-character spelling error tolerance, and sorting according to the selection record. Users can also invoke cross-browser search from any app, perform link copying, page reload, repeat tag cleaning, and folder opening. Fixed label recovery, automatic cleanup of idle labels, menu bar lists, and custom shortcuts further simplify day-to-day management.

item.title: Notchi 0.9.46
item.description:
macOS Notch Smart Assistant

Notchi is a native macOS tool that transforms the Mac notch area into a shortcut for input and an intelligent task portal. Users simply move their mouse near the notch and enter natural language to jot down ideas, create time-based reminders, ask AI questions, or invoke a coding agent to handle project tasks. The software can recognize input intent, store ordinary content in memos, directly convert sentences like "Call Mom tomorrow at 9:00 a.m." into system reminders, and support online searches, source citations, clipboard screenshot recognition, and precise mathematical calculations. For development tasks, users can specify a project folder and describe their requirements, which are then executed in the background by the native Codex or Claude CLI. Even after the notch is closed, the current step and time elapsed are still displayed, and a system notification is sent when the task is completed. Notchi uses a Liquid Glass material that harmonizes with the macOS style, seamlessly integrating the panel and screen bezel through background blur, edge lighting, and fluid animations. The classification of the input is completed locally. The issue will be sent directly to the corresponding platform using the service provider key selected by the user, without passing through the developer's server.

item.title: FanBar 0.11.1
item.description:
Mac Fan Control Tool

FanBar is a native macOS menu bar temperature monitoring and fan control tool that supports macOS 11 Big Sur and later for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that can provide readable fan data via AppleSMC. The software displays the CPU temperature, average fan speed, or a combination of the two in the menu bar, and presents the temperature change through a scrolling chart for the last ten minutes, reading the GPU, SSD, and battery temperature when the hardware supports it. Everyday use keeps macOS under automatic thermal management, and after approving a signed control service, you can set a fixed speed, or choose mute, equalize, performance, and extreme thermal presets. Each preset has an independently editable temperature and speed curve that supports CPU, GPU or SSD temperature as the basis for adjustment, and can also restore system control after a specified time. The software provides protection against high-temperature notifications, hardware rpm limits, and attempts to restore automatic control in the event of an abnormality. macOS 14 and later also adds a desktop widget to view the heat dissipation status, and the widget refresh is scheduled by the system.

item.title: WaifuX 38.0.161
item.description:
Open-source ACG anime live wallpaper software

WaifuX is an open-source, all-in-one ACG app for macOS that brings together static wallpapers, live wallpapers, and anime videos, covering the entire user experience from browsing and filtering to setting wallpapers as your desktop with a single click. Static wallpapers support switching between two sources, Wallhaven and 4K Wall, covering all resolutions from 4K to 8K. Dynamic wallpapers connect to sources like MotionBGs to bring your desktop to life. Anime videos feature a built-in multi-source parsing engine, allowing you to watch and follow your favorite series all within the same app. Smart search supports multi-dimensional filtering by keywords, tags, categories, colors, and resolutions. The collection system allows you to build your personal ACG resource library and set different wallpapers for each display. Importing local folders allows for centralized management of personal collections. The experimental Wallpaper Engine rendering pipeline can render scenes and Web-type live wallpapers and only supports Apple Silicon. The app requires macOS 14 or later, is compatible with Apple Silicon and Intel, offers interfaces in Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese, and can be installed via the official website, GitHub Releases, or Homebrew. It is suitable for anime fans to change wallpapers and follow anime series on a daily basis.

item.title: Motty 0.4.34
item.description:
Native SSH Client for Mac

Motty is a native SSH client for macOS that integrates a terminal, SFTP file management, port forwarding, VNC and RDP remote desktops, and an AI assistant into a single window. It is ideal for server maintenance, remote development, and multi-host management. The software is built using the Go and Viva frameworks, does not rely on Electron or an embedded browser, and supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. The terminal offers multiple tabs, horizontal and vertical split screens, history search, session recording, input broadcasting, and over 200 color schemes. It also allows you to view the processor, memory, disk, and network status of the remote host in the sidebar. The file panel supports recursive transfer, breakpoint resume, permission adjustment, and remote text editing, and can also follow the terminal directory. Hosts can be organized by groups and tags, and connection configurations can be imported from tools such as OpenSSH, PuTTY, and MobaXterm. The built-in AI assistant can answer questions based on the terminal context, execute commands after approval, and provide tools to external agents through an optional MCP interface.

item.title: magpie 0.1.4839
item.description:
AI Programming Agent Model Switching

magpie is an open source model routing tool for AI programming agents that runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux and unifies different agents and model services through a native gateway. After adding providers such as DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, etc., you can select the corresponding model among the agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, etc., without duplicating the key configuration for each agent. magpie can convert interface formats such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, and retain streaming response, tool call, and inference capabilities; it also supports connecting logged-in subscriptions such as Claude, ChatGPT, and GitHub Copilot to other agents. Users can set up intelligent model routing for different tasks, assign requests according to their intent, or automatically switch accounts according to account quota, reset time, rate limit, and fault conditions to reduce request interruptions.

item.title: Capture 3.8.1
item.description:
Note-taking and idea-gathering tool for macOS

Quick Notes – Capture is a quick note-taking and idea-gathering tool for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, and Apple Watch, with a core experience centered around low-friction input, instant organization, and cross-app flow. It is suitable for first capturing spontaneous ideas, to-do lists, web links, image attachments, voice content, and reminders, and then exporting them as needed to commonly used tools such as Obsidian, Things, Todoist, iA Writer, Craft, OmniFocus, Fantastical, Apple Calendar, Reminders, etc. The software supports iCloud syncing, desktop and lock screen widgets, share extensions, Siri and Shortcuts, automatic recognition of dates and URLs, document scanning, list sorting, merging and splitting of records, and other features. It can serve both as a daily outlet for clearing your mind and as a hub between different productivity systems. Its interface emphasizes simplicity and stability, avoiding distractions caused by complex workflows, allowing users to quickly save ideas when inspiration strikes and then process, archive, or execute them at the appropriate time.

item.title: FileZilla Pro 3.72.1
item.description:
Professional SFTP File Transfer Tool for Mac

FileZilla Pro is a professional file transfer and cloud storage management client for macOS. It can connect to remote servers via FTP, FTPS, SFTP, and WebDAV, and natively supports services such as Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Google Drive, Google Cloud Storage, Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft Azure Storage, Dropbox, Box, and OpenStack Swift. The software features a tabbed interface, allowing users to centrally organize servers, cloud sites, and bookmarks using the Site Manager. It also protects login credentials and synchronized data through an encryption mechanism. It offers features such as local and remote directory comparison, directory synchronization, file search, list filtering, remote file editing, and drag-and-drop transfer. It can use transfer queues to uniformly manage progress in tasks involving a large number of files, with no restrictions on individual file sizes.

item.title: Darkroom 7.7
item.description:
Professional photo editing and management app

Darkroom is an advanced photo and video editing app for iPad and iPhone that deeply blends the latest features of iOS and iPadOS to provide fast, powerful, and easy-to-use editing tools for photographers of all levels. It offers a wide range of free tools for editing Live photos, raw images, and portrait photos, as well as video editing with real-time color grading. Its core features include the most easy-to-use curve and selective color tools on iOS, portrait blur editing, raw editing, full album management, and the ability to create personalized filters. Darkroom also supports batch processing, import-free instant access, integrated tag manager, and Siri shortcuts, providing a feature-rich editing suite that is now available for macOS. With its advanced AI editing technology and professional-grade features, Darkroom offers users an editing experience on par with Adobe Lightroom and Canva, making it ideal for photography and video projects.

item.title: Eye Monitor 13.1.23
item.description:
Smart break reminder tool

Eye Monitor – Break Reminders, an iOS app that works with macOS apps, has gained traction on platforms like Hacker News, Product Hunt, and sspai.com, and ranks # 1 in health and fitness apps in 13 countries. The app alerts users when their Mac's fatigue reaches a preset threshold and prevents them from indulging in the phone while away from the computer. Its macOS version is a fully automated fatigue monitoring and alerting tool designed to help users rest, relax, and reduce fatigue. Eye Monitor automatically analyzes the user's behavior, such as mouse, trackpad, scroll wheel movement, and keyboard input, to notify the user that the fatigue threshold has been reached. The app can be used as a rest reminder, hydration reminder, stretch reminder, screen time reminder, RSI reminder, etc. to help users maintain eye health and improve sitting-related issues. Eye Monitor is an app designed to help users reduce visual fatigue and stay healthy, and works with macOS versions.

item.title: Trellis File Manager 2.6
item.description:
powerful file manager for macOS

Trellis File Manager is a visual file management tool designed for Mac that places each open folder in a separate panel on the canvas and displays the folder hierarchy via a path connection for easy side-by-side viewing, drag-and-drop movement, and comparison of content. The software supports tree alignment to the right or down, manual positioning, smooth zooming, trackpad zooming, and canvas dragging, and can manage different tasks using workspaces, favorites, Finder labels, and color branches. Built-in indexes quickly display folder sizes, search for files, locate results, and view disk usage through a space view. It supports local disks, removable hard disks, SD cards, network sharing, and a variety of cloud disk locations, and can record the directory and preview information of disconnected drives. File operations include breakpoint resurfacing, folder merging with the same name, batch renaming, undo recovery, folder comparison, and duplicate file lookup, while galleries support photo, video, PDF, Office document, font, and 3D model previews, as well as image conversion and compression. The software does not require an account, the index remains native, is compatible with Apple chips and Intel Macs, and provides a multilingual interface.

item.title: QuickNote 7.14.0
item.description:
Mac Desktop Notes Tool

Quick Note is a simple note-taking app that allows users to take notes quickly with a single click or with shortcut keys. The software is a lightweight menu bar app that optimizes the experience of taking quick notes. The notes window always hovers over the other apps, making sure the notes are always visible. Its main features include iCloud sync, floating windows, rich background color selection, folder organization, notes created through services, useful widgets, transparency adjustments, favorite notes, notes expansion and collapse, multiple text styles, and automation through shortcuts and Apple scripts. the iCloud sync feature keeps all your notes always backed up and seamlessly syncs with the iCloud account associated with your Apple ID, making it incredibly easy to use. Users can categorize notes into folders for easy management. Create new notes directly from other apps for greater efficiency. For professional users, Quick Note can be integrated into automated workflows to further increase productivity. If you're looking to increase the convenience and visibility of your daily notes, Quick Note is definitely an ideal choice.

item.title: LanScan 8.2.19
item.description:
Mac LAN Device Scan Tool

LanScan is a simple and efficient network scanning tool that supports IPv4 and IPv6 and is able to discover all active devices within any subnet, including local subnets or any user-configured public subnets. For IPv4, LanScan automatically detects configured interfaces (such as Airport, Ethernet, virtual interfaces, etc.) and supports scanning from a single IP to the entire IPv4 address space. It scans the local network with ARP packets, the public IP network range with Ping, SMB, mDNS packets, and displays the IP address, MAC address, up to four hostnames, and associated vendor information. LanScan can also discover SMB domains (if configured), support hostname resolution for DNS, mDNS (Apple devices) and SMB (Windows devices), allow custom hostname editing and add custom comments for each device, can also open custom URLs in the browser, and support exporting results as CSV files, users can freely hide/display columns, and align columns according to personal preferences, no number of devices found ‘attributes’ associated with the account.

item.title: KeyClicker 2.10.0
item.description:
macOS typewriter mechanical keyboard sound effect

KeyClicker is a keyboard sound enhancement tool designed for Mac. It plays simulated mechanical keyboard and typewriter key sounds when the user types on the keyboard, making everyday typing more rhythmic, responsive, and immersive. The software offers a wide range of built-in sound effects, supporting key press sounds, key release sounds, or both simultaneously. You can also set custom sounds for different keys and add variety to the input process through the random sound mode. It also supports displaying the currently pressed keys and shortcuts on the desktop, and can add text watermarks, making it suitable for recording lessons, creating software demonstrations, live streaming, or sharing operational processes. KeyClicker resides in the menu bar, allowing users to quickly check the current status, switch sounds, display keys, or enable/disable features, making settings management more convenient. In addition to typewriter and mechanical keyboard sounds, the software also includes mouse clicks, game sounds, notification sounds, error sounds, animal sounds, and a variety of fun sound effects, making it suitable for Mac users who write, program, create content, or want an ASMR-style input experience. The software supports multiple languages, including Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean, and requires macOS 14 or later.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.64
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.
